# Exterior

The most important come first.

## Rivals

### Ledgerpad

It locks notes in. [Its page](https://ledgerpad.example/plans) says why (read 2026-11-20).

## Vendors

### Acme Storage

Its prices set what sync costs ([its prices](https://acme.example/prices), read 2026-11-24).

## Forces

### Open Notes Format

The format changes each year. [The draft](https://acme.example/format) is open. Our reader read 2026-11-24 as its day.

## Watch

Their prices, and the format.
